nodes.title: Runnable 43-case MCP conformance corpus and httpx runner (local targets only)
nodes.summary: 06-corpus/mcp_lc_corpus.py, corpus_ext.py, mock_upstream.py, targets*.json, corpus_expected.json. Implements the r2 33-case manifest (19 executed on at least one target; 14 not black-box testable: client-side OAuth cases, inspector-only, launcher-only, websocket NA, tasks, ssrf, openapi) plus 10 new cases for spec 2026-07-28 (header/body consistency, version negotiation, removed surface, no session id). Verdicts PASS/FAIL/WARN/NA/ERR; 'rejected' requires a 4xx or JSON-RPC error and an unchanged handler-call counter. Loopback-only guard.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Toy echo servers; counter unavailable for docker gateway.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Found real defects in most builds that the conformance suite passes.

nodes.title: Listener-gate delta for spec 2026-07-28: add, modify, drop
nodes.summary: ADD: header/body consistency (MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name -> 400 + -32020), unsupported version -> 400 + -32022, no Mcp-Session-Id, removed methods -> 404 + -32601, GET endpoint 405, simple-request cannot reach (custom headers force preflight; Origin MUST remains). MODIFY: session-principal-binding becomes state-handle binding (spec: possession of a handle is not authentication); session-route-pin becomes requestState/task handle sealing; session-table-bound becomes bounded handle stores, legacy window only; task cases move to the tasks extension. DROP from listener corpus: proxy-token-required, token-not-to-app-origin, path-allowlist, scheme-allowlist, verify-default-on, argv-injection. Deprecated (earliest removal 2027-07-28 or later): Roots, Sampling, Logging, DCR, includeContext, HTTP+SSE; nothing is in the Removed registry yet.
nodes.overclaim_risk: Derived from spec text plus four modern-capable servers.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Statelessness moves classes rather than removing them.

nodes.title: No dated MCP revision newer than 2026-07-28 as of 2026-10-25
nodes.summary: Spec repo (HEAD 2026-10-23) has dated dirs through 2026-07-28 plus draft; draft changelog is empty; deprecated registry has no Removed entries. Conformance npm latest 0.1.16, alpha 0.2.0-alpha.12 (2026-10-01) with requirement sets 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28.

nodes.title: Default-config vs configurable failures
nodes.summary: Default-off but configurable: rmcp 3.7.0 Origin allowlist empty (Origin check off; with_allowed_origins fixes); agentgateway 1.6.0 mcp.dnsRebindingProtection off by default (true fixes host, origin and h2 authority checks; issue 1855); agentgateway mcpAuthentication audiences unset disables audience validation (wrong-audience tokens accepted; set rejects); py mcp 2.3.0 protection only when bound to loopback; ts createMcpHandler has no host/origin guard by design; ts sdk 1.32.2 express checks Host only; agentgateway docs example with wildcard cors reflects arbitrary origin. Not configurable in tested builds: duplicate JSON method key last-wins reaches handler (py, ts); BOM accepted (ts, py 1.30, py2 modern); agentgateway session id not bound to principal; agentgateway forwards client Authorization to upstream (token passthrough); docker-mcp 0.44.2 accepts a 64 MiB body (RSS 42 MB to 696 MB). Passing by default: docker-mcp random bearer and Host/Origin checks. Session stores: py caps at 10000 then returns 503; rmcp unbounded (about 52 KB per session); ts stateless variants flat.
nodes.overclaim_risk: RSS is a noisy proxy; defaults are quickstart wiring.
nodes.underclaim_risk: Libraries are not products; gateways with policies pass more.

nodes.title: Conformance 0.2.0-alpha.12 dns-rebinding scenario does not require Origin validation
nodes.summary: rmcp 3.7.0 default scores 2/2 on dns-rebinding-protection while the corpus origin-only case fails. http-header-validation 14/14 on py2, ts createMcpHandler, rmcp, agentgateway; low scores on legacy-only servers. server-stateless mostly 'not testable' without diagnostic tools. Open issues 570 and 553 describe untested/under-graded SEP-2243 requirements.
